ModMetaData.name: RimMT V0.9.3-T34D.2.3 Self-Conflict Cleanup
ModMetaData.author: Allen / Rimworld-Project
ModMetaData.description: RimMT T34-D.2.3 for RimWorld 1.5. Retires the near-zero-yield T34-A gameplay prefix and Global Haul consumer while retaining T34-B snapshot publication, proven job-search filters, reservation/reachability transactions, and T34-D worker validation. Scanner types that produce a completed worker wait above 8ms are quarantined. Includes one-shot cleanup of the retired WaitProbe save component and coalesces one redundant post-load Unity asset cleanup after an entry cleanup.
